2607.12468.title: An Omnilingual-ASR-Based Speech-LLM System for the 2nd MLC-SLM Challenge
2607.12468.paper_summary: We describe our submission to Task 1 of the 2nd MLCSLM Challenge: a cascaded diarization-then-recognition system that combines DiariZen-Large-s80 (WavLM-Large) segmentation, CAM++ embedding-based two-speaker clustering, and a LoRA-adapted omniASR LLM 7B v2 recognizer, with no oracle segmentation or speaker labels at test time. On the official Development set (150 conversations, 21 language/accent categories) the system attains a macro tcpMER of 29.27%, versus 79.15% for the official baseline; on the Evaluation set it scores 50.23%. We also analyze two engineering choices that substantially affect tcpMER. First, embedding-based speaker clustering outperforms an end-to-end-style alternative that assigns speakers from ASR <sc> turn markers alone. Second, overlap-aware segmentation, although intended to raise diarization recall, increases tcpMER because overlapped speech is transcribed twice.
2607.12468.paper_summary_zh: 我們描述我們對第二屆 MLCSLM 挑戰賽任務 1 的提交：一個級聯的分段-然後-識別系統，結合了 DiariZen-Large-s80 (WavLM-Large) 分段、基於 CAM++ 嵌入的兩講者聚類，以及經過 LoRA 調整的 omniASR LLM 7B v2 識別器，在測試時不使用預設的分段或講者標籤。在官方開發集（150 次對話，21 種語言/口音類別）上，該系統達到 29.27% 的宏 tcpMER，而官方基準為 79.15%；在評估集上得分為 50.23%。我們還分析了兩個對 tcpMER 產生重大影響的工程選擇。首先，基於嵌入的講者聚類優於僅依賴 ASR <sc> 轉換標記分配講者的端到端風格替代方案。其次，雖然重疊感知分段旨在提高分段召回率，但由於重疊語音被轉錄兩次，這反而增加了 tcpMER。
2607.12468.author: Shuming Fang et.al.
